task.instruction: Prioritize the setup model for a publishing tool used by experienced editors and first-time contributors.
task.deliverable: A priority decision for setup control, mandatory publication fields, and cited evidence.

evidence.content: In synthetic trials, experienced editors finished free-form setup 24% faster; first-time contributors omitted ownership metadata in 5 of 18 attempts.
A synthetic publication-governance rule requires a named owner, intended audience, and accessibility metadata before any item can be published, independent of the setup flow.
A guided setup removed all ownership omissions but added four minutes for experienced editors and doubled skip-button use.

A.content: When participants have the needed context, preserve their discretion over how to reach the declared outcome.

B.content: When consistency or unfamiliarity matters, provide a clearer path and decision support toward the declared outcome.

irrelevant.content: Use descriptive file names for any attached artifacts.
